Buy a Turkish ID Card on Telegram

There is no single market price for a Turkish id card. There are three, for a print, for correct stock, and for a number that resolves at the Nufus Mudurlugu. Adverts blur all three into one figure.

Document type
An ID card is a domestic identity document issued by a civil registry, police force or municipal office. It proves identity inside the country and usually nothing outside it.

Buy a ID Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

Most Turkish id card sellers work through a channel that posts stock and a chat that closes the sale. The channel is marketing. The chat is where you find out whether the person knows the document.

Keep the photos the seller sends. When the parcel arrives, photograph the unopened envelope before you open it, then the document beside the envelope. That sequence ties the document to the seller.

Who actually issues a ID Card

The Turkish id card is a state product made by the Nufus Mudurlugu. Replicas copy the look, registered originals carry a number in the office records, and both are sold on Telegram as if they were the same thing.

Number formats are the one part of this that a buyer can always test without equipment. Look up the format for Turkey and compare digit by digit. It takes a minute and settles most arguments.

Replica or registered original

If the card only has to look right across a counter, a print is enough and the bottom of the band is fair. If a number has to be looked up, pay the top and make the seller prove the lookup first.

This is the single most useful distinction on the page, because it explains the price spread better than anything else. A quote tells you which tier the seller thinks you are in.

What a fair price looks like

Price is the easiest thing to compare and the least informative. Two adverts at the same figure can differ completely in stock, number and delivery, and the figure shows you none of it.

The table below splits the band into the three tiers so you can see what each figure is actually for. Read it before you open a chat and you will not anchor on whatever number the seller opens with.

The buying process, step by step

The steps below are deliberately boring. Boring is what a Turkish id card purchase should feel like.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the Nufus Mudurlugu.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the Nufus Mudurlugu uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 1500–5500 TRY band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the tests that matter for a Turkish id card. The two local ones are worth memorising.

  • Check the identity card for the citizen number and confirm it against the published algorithm.
  • Confirm the passport coat of arms and the machine-readable zone check digits.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the Nufus Mudurlugu. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

Any one of these is enough to walk away. Two together is a pattern.

  • An identity card whose citizen number fails the mod eleven algorithm.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

How much is an ID card on Telegram?

Between 90 and 500 US dollars. A print sits at the bottom, a chip card with a valid number at the top.

Is an ID card worth buying at all?

It is the cheapest document to fake convincingly, so it is also the one most often faked badly. Buy it only with a number check.

Do ID cards work abroad?

Inside the issuing country, yes. Outside it, most are only accepted as secondary evidence.

What is the giveaway on a fake ID?

The number. It is the one part that has to obey a rule, and sellers who invent numbers rarely know the rule.

Can I check an ID number myself?

In most countries yes, because the algorithm is published. Search for the country name and check digit.

Before you pay

The band for a Turkish id card in Turkey is 1500–5500 TRY. Anything else needs a reason, so ask for it.
